cases.notes: Native load/ABI/transport failure classification verified by NativeBridge.VerifyManifest hash check, ABI version check, and cargo test tests::version_and_repeated_output_lifecycle.
Missing native asset fails before dispatch; verified by NativeBridge.Load which throws when the asset or manifest is absent and by eng/Test-NativePackageAssets.ps1 which requires the exact file set.
Mismatched native asset hash fails before dispatch; verified by NativeBridge.VerifyManifest SHA-256 comparison and eng/Test-NativePackageAssets.ps1 manifest hash check.
Wrong-RID native asset fails before dispatch; verified by NativeBridge.Platform() which rejects unsupported operating system and process architecture combinations.
Incompatible native asset ABI fails before dispatch; verified by NativeBridge ABI version bridge constructor check and eng/Test-NativePackageAssets.ps1 abiVersion assertion.
